command: set -eu; exec_dir="${VERIFIER_EXEC_DIR:?require_exec=true needs VERIFIER_EXEC_DIR}"; mkdir -p "$exec_dir"; export GOPROXY=off; go build -o "$exec_dir/f2p_runner" ./tests/f2p_runner; exec "$exec_dir/f2p_runner" -select "$1" -report "$2"

import os,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]);out=Path(os.environ['VERIFIER_PREPARATION_DIR']);os.environ['GOPROXY']='off';os.environ['GOTMPDIR']=os.environ['VERIFIER_EXEC_DIR']
import hashlib
manifest=lambda:{str(f.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in root.rglob('*') if f.is_file()}
before=manifest()
subprocess.run(['go','build','-buildvcs=false','-o',str(out/'f2p_runner'),'./tests/f2p_runner'],cwd=root,check=True)
for pkg in ['.', './internal/fieldval', './internal/validators', './locales/ruru', './locales/zhcn', './locales/zhtw', './tests']:
 subprocess.run(['go','test','-c','-buildvcs=false','-o',str(out/(pkg.replace('/','_')+'.test')),pkg],cwd=root,check=True)
after=manifest();print('PREPARATION_CHANGED_PATHS', sorted(k for k in before.keys()|after.keys() if before.get(k)!=after.get(k)),flush=True)
